title: Collision Repair Work Order Form
subtitle: Collision Repair: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Collision Repair Work Order Form covers damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need. The collision repair coordinator records Collision Repair authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Collision Repair Work Order Form keeps Collision Repair exceptions visible until the collision repair coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Collision Repair Work Order Form at intake area, body bay, frame or measurement area, refinish area, and delivery point. Document damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need identity before Collision Repair begins. Compare damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need findings with stated Collision Repair criteria; route unresolved Collision Repair issues to qualified collision and structural repair reviewer. For Collision Repair Work Order Form, confirm requirements for Collision Repair. Ask qualified collision and structural repair reviewer to review Collision Repair conditions beyond the collision repair coordinator's role.
